name: Shopify Payments

evidence.gateway: F02: integrated gateway; the seller sells and stays responsible for the transaction
evidence.links: F16: Quick Sale sends a payment link; Buy Buttons send buyers to Shopify Checkout
evidence.crypto: C01: USDC checkout in eligible regions and networks only; no Bitcoin through this offer

line: Integrated card and local payment processing for Shopify stores.

free.text: Requires a paid Shopify plan; no free Payments plan

cells.countries: US, UK, Germany; India not supported
cells.payout: 3 business days to payout; bank arrival adds 1–3 days

fee.math: The standard online card rate for the US Basic plan. The Shopify plan subscription is paid separately.
